ov_board_row_tip: A channel of the plug-in board on port E (not one of the MU's parts). Right-click to choose its voice, double-click to open it in the Voice window.
ov_board_no_voices: The board has no voices yet
ov_bighint: Double-click to edit in a big window
ov_bighint_master: Double-click to edit in the master window
ov_var_off_fmt:
%s  %s
Variation is connected as INSERTION, so this value is unused
ov_slider_fmt:
%s  %s
Drag sideways or up/down, wheel, or double-click to type a value
ov_unhook_sys: Remove from this part, back to SYSTEM
ov_drag_note:
Drag the mark onto another part's INS cell to move it.
Applying it while still NO EFFECT silences the part.
ov_drag_note2:
Grab it and drop it onto a part's INS cell to apply it.
Applying it while still NO EFFECT silences the part.
ov_tip_ins_fmt:
%s: %s
Double-click for settings, drag to another part, right-click for type and removal
ov_tip_var_fmt:
%s: %s
Drag to another part, right-click for type and removal
ov_peg_hint:
Left dot: up/down for the starting pitch
Middle dot: sideways for the attack time
Right dot: sideways for the release time, up/down for the release level
ov_porta_hint: Drag a dot sideways (right for longer, left for shorter)
ov_filter_hint:
Right dot: sideways for cutoff (right is brighter), up/down for resonance (up is stronger)
Left dot: sideways for HPF (right cuts more bass)
ov_eq_pt_hint: Drag a dot: sideways for frequency, up/down for gain (1 is bass, 2 is treble)
ov_eq_master_hint: Drag a dot: sideways for frequency, up/down for gain. Wheel near a dot for width (Q)
ov_vib_hint:
Top of the wave: sideways for speed, up/down for depth
End of the flat part: sideways for the delay
ov_kb_audition_tip:
Left-click to play (lower is louder). Right-click to mark a key for voice audition, right-click again to clear it
Mark as many keys as you like for a chord; with no mark, changing voice plays nothing. Marks are per part and are not remembered
PC keyboard plays too, white keys only: the A row from C3, the Q row an octave up, the number row another octave up. Hold Z to flatten or X to sharpen what you play. Shift holds the modulation wheel up. PageUp / PageDown shift the octave
ov_kb_play_tip: Press to play (either mouse button). Lower is louder
ov_mod_tip_fmt:
Modulation (CC1)  %d
Wheel (Ctrl for coarse), or drag up/down
ov_move_tip_fmt:
%s: %s → %s
Double-click for settings, right-click for type and part, drag onto a part's INS cell
ov_drag_to_fmt: Drop %s (%s) onto a part's INS cell
ov_master_name_tip: Double-click for the master window (master volume, transpose, effect returns, master EQ)
ov_engine_tip:
Sounding engine (F4 switches)
firmware: the real firmware plays (effects as on hardware)
native: SH-2 stopped, registers built from formulas
ov_voices_tip:
Voices: sounding voices, including releases. Some voices use two or more voices per note
M is the SWP30 master (up to 64, blue), S the slave (up to 64, orange). Overflow goes to the slave
ov_cpu_tip: CPU: audio processing time vs deadline (over 100%% breaks up)
ov_zoom_label: Display size (double-click a small picture to enlarge)
ov_env_vol_long: Volume  Attack %.0f ms   Decay 2000+ ms   Release %.0f ms
ov_env_vol: Volume  Attack %.0f ms   Decay %.0f ms   Release %.0f ms
ov_env_pitch: Pitch  Init %+.0f cent   Attack %.0f ms   Release %.0f ms → %+.0f cent
ov_mod_wheel_hint:
MODULATION WHEEL (CC1)  %d
Modulation wheel. Drag or wheel up/down. Higher adds more of the right side's MW LFO PMOD DEPTH vibrato (sends CC1 to the receive channel)
